contract.task_clause:
What is the major advantage of organizational publications?
Option A: Their ability to provide a revenue source for sponsoring organizations
Option B: Their ability to deliver specific, detailed information to narrowly defined target publics
Option C: Their ability to avoid the problems typically associated with two-way media
Option D: Their ability to give sponsoring organizations a means of uncontrolled communications
